With 3+ years of experience as a Python Backend Developer, I
specialize in building scalable APIs and reliable backend systems
using Django, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and PostgreSQL.

Artificial Intelligence, particularly Natural Language Processing (NLP)
and Machine Learning. I have contributed to projects such as data
extraction using OCR, SpaCy, and Regex, and chatbots powered by
LLMs, integrating intelligent solutions into production systems. This
gives me a unique edge in building smarter, data-driven applications.
Passionate about clean architecture, performance, and collaboration,
I thrive in agile environments where I can deliver impactful products
while continuously expanding my expertise.
